items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I was working out in Atlantic Beach in a room that Mosey Alexander, the drummer has something to do with.

ctx.x: So I'd make out a lead sheet with the chords on there and give it to the piano player and we'd try it and if it worked out well we'd put it back

into the repertoire again. So, and of course they're new to alot of people. In fact, I did "Loch Loman" the other night and you won't believe this, I tried not to do it. I tried not to push it down anybody's throat. So just last Saturday I was working out in Atlantic Beach in a room that Mosey Alexander, the drummer has something to do with. Of course Mosey has had a stroke. He's not there now. His son is playing drums. But there was a woman there and she insisted upon my doing "Loch Loman". Well I put her off…
